Deliver [session orientation](../session-orientation/spec.md) so a fresh agent can inspect goals, current commitments, ready work, and unresolved decisions before requesting detailed task context. Show eligible work with reasons and retain useful known information with explicit gaps.

full_context_consumption.method: Consumed each JSON-derived full source text with its path and inclusion reasons in this session. Large source displays were split, and portions hidden by tool-output truncation were displayed again before any repository write.

read_only_boundary.scope: Every project file, including tracked, untracked and ignored files, plus every .git file. File snapshots compare paths, kinds, permission modes, sizes and SHA-256 digests. Symlinks compare their own target strings without traversal. Git commands use GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0. Directory mtimes and file access times are intentionally excluded.
read_only_boundary.manifest_digest_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(entries,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon)) without a trailing newline, in os.walk directory and file name order.

criteria_results.evidence: Retained reader digest matches the handoff. The predecessor was completed with valid acceptance in the first orientation. The successful preflight and its actual source manifest were inspected after selection.

Fresh session received the reader, explicit scope and pickup objective without a selected ticket or the earlier planning conversation. Its first reader project query was orient with normal default limits. Captured ticket bytes show unstarted execution and orientation shows commitment membership.

The actor chose the sole eligible item. Selection records unstarted execution, current commitment, ready-for-agent triage and passing acceptance_criteria, required_context, dependencies and blocking_decisions checks.

After selection, context returned all 26 sources with both completeness values true. All full texts, paths and reasons were consumed before the in-progress edit. Every text matches its source bytes and SHA-256.

Command captures retain exact arrays, directories, environment overrides, timestamps, exits and output digests. Source manifests retain paths, SHA-256 and reasons. Reader identity and exact original selected-ticket bytes are retained.

Comparison of both formats passed for project facts, work groups, all 13 work items, checks, dependency edges, acceptance metadata, snapshots and all 82 orientation sources. All five completed reader tickets are retained with valid acceptance and excluded from the shortlist.
Before explicit authoring, complete snapshots of 239 project files and 709 .git files are equal, and all seven Git command results match. Raw captures stayed outside the repository.

Separate guidance sources are listed in unlinked_guidance. Authored links determine task context. The observation does not infer automatic discovery, evidence grading, human approval or current-checkout certification from historical acceptance.

No reader or comparison failure occurred. Tool display truncation was corrected by smaller JSON-derived reads before authoring. Later coordinator provenance corrections and the in-progress observation are separate from the preserved pickup snapshot.

This actor recorded only in-progress execution and new immutable evidence. Acceptance checklist, current Acceptance, completion and final validation remain with the coordinator. The specification is unchanged by this actor.

limitations: Read-only equality compares the two recorded boundaries and does not assert atomic filesystem isolation.

Code identity was checked against the retained source manifest and matching source commit. The Go test, race, vet, build and minimum-Go outcomes remain attributed to the predecessor preflight. This actor did not rerun those suites.
Historical Acceptance metadata is an authored assertion. This trial did not grade that evidence or authenticate actors or human approval.

The coordinator reported provenance-only corrections after the read-only boundary, then authored replacements and superseding acceptance. The original pickup sources and facts remain unchanged in this evidence.
Acceptance criterion 10 remains pending the coordinator closeout. No completed execution, accepted ticket, completed milestone or specification rewrite is claimed by this observation.

source_path_encoding.rule: Within these fields, replace any object whose sole key is $path with source_path_table[index]. Every decoded value is the exact absolute path from the captured reader output. Command argument arrays remain literal.
